item.title: US aviation shutdown leaves four major airlines facing a $345 million hit after 18,500 cancellations
item.description: On November 13, 2026, the aviation sector faced a massive disruption as over 18,500 flights were canceled across the United States. This chaos was triggered by the Federal Aviation Administration's ground stop due to a malfunction with aging communications technology. Major airlines, particularly American Airlines and JetBlue, struggled the most. Passengers experienced extended wait times and were eligible for refunds.

item.title: Martine Moise enters Haiti's first presidential election in a decade
item.description: Martine Moise has officially entered the race for Haiti's upcoming presidential election set for July next year, marking a significant moment as it will be the first election in almost a decade. Amidst ongoing security concerns and political turmoil, Moise's candidacy is particularly poignant given her ties to recent events. With 33 candidates on the ballot, Haitian voters will face critical choices that could reshape the country's political future.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: New York woman fights neighbours over ownership of land strip she maintained for 29 years
item.description: Lauren Sullivan, a resident of New York, has initiated a legal battle over a slender strip of land she maintains between her home and her neighbors'. Having cared for this space for almost three decades, Sullivan's lawsuit proceeds after the court denied a dismissal request. Her neighbors, Lisa and John Walts, challenge her claim, stating her long-term maintenance isn't sufficient under the law.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Canadian teacher's death inspires charity that has donated more than $5 million to children over 13 years
item.description: A Canadian charity named Noelle's Gift to Children has reached a significant milestone by distributing $5 million. In the past year, the charity provided $259,200 in funding to two school boards. This funding assists students with essential items such as food, clothing, and healthcare needs. The charity originated in 2013 after a kindergarten teacher's tragic death.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Warren Buffett donates $5.47 billion more, taking family charity gifts past $29 billion
item.description: Warren Buffett has ramped up his charitable efforts, revealing a staggering donation of Berkshire Hathaway shares valued at $5.47 billion. This sizable contribution focuses primarily on four family-operated charities, with a significant portion directed to the Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation. With an earlier donation nearing $6 billion, his total charitable giving surpasses $11.4 billion in 2026.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Warren Buffett donates $5.47 billion in Berkshire shares to four charities, backs successor Greg Abel
item.description: Warren Buffett has donated approximately $5.47 billion worth of Berkshire Hathaway shares to four charitable foundations associated with his three children. The 96-year-old billionaire also reiterated his confidence in successor Greg Abel, saying his faith in Berkshire Hathaway's new leadership remains as strong as ever. The donation takes his total charitable contributions beyond $29 billion.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'I may not return alive': Ex-Pakistan PM Imran Khan seeks urgent medical help
item.description: Imran Khan has appealed to Pakistan's top courts for urgent medical care for himself and his wife. He claims that his health has deteriorated significantly during solitary confinement, where he is held for up to 22 hours daily. Khan alleges that authorities neglected previous court orders regarding his medical treatment and communication with family. He expressed concern for his wife's rapidly declining vision and health after a recent surgery.

item.title: H-E-B surprises 10,000 Texas shoppers with $100 gift cards worth $1 million
item.description: On November 14, H-E-B surprised customers by distributing $1 million worth of gift cards, providing a significant boost to 10,000 shoppers during grocery checkout. This generous giveaway of $100 gift cards aims to alleviate the financial strain many face as the holidays approach. H-E-B's initiative underscores their dedication to uplifting Texas communities, showcasing how thoughtful gestures can have a meaningful impact in tough economic times.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Jake Gyllenhaal joins celebrity auction supporting homes for injured veterans
item.description: Jake Gyllenhaal is joining the 10th annual Veterans Day Celebrity Auction, presented by Homes For Our Troops. This auction provides fans a unique opportunity to bid on exclusive experiences and memorabilia while supporting injured veterans. Bidding is open from November 10 until November 20, 2026, with proceeds aiding the construction of adapted, mortgage-free homes for veterans with serious injuries.

item.title: Massachusetts cinema gets another $10 million gift, bringing $23 million restoration closer to reality
item.description: West Newton Cinema is nearing the end of its restoration effort, thanks to a generous $10 million donation. This funding aims to improve accessibility and bolster ongoing construction. A cherished part of the community, the cinema features a diverse array of films and events. Looking ahead, future renovations will refresh seating and the exterior, with hopes of gathering the final funding through community contributions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 570 Rocky lookalikes set Guinness World Record at Philadelphia Museum steps 50 years after film
item.description: On November 13, 570 fans dressed in grey tracksuits gathered at the Philadelphia Museum of Art to set a record. Participants included individuals from across the globe, including countries like Germany and Hungary. The event celebrated 50 years since the iconic film Rocky was released, highlighting its cultural significance. After the record announcement, attendees enjoyed running up the museum steps while chanting Rocky's name.
